location: Printed p. 305 (PDF p. 1), Paying to Know, right column
quote: Sixty-six subjects were presented with ... were presented to two different groups ... of 67 subjects each
reason: The target omnibus test (Cramer's V = 0.218) compares choices across all three between-subjects conditions of the Paying to Know problem: the Disjunctive group (n = 66), the Pass group (n = 67), and the Fail group (n = 67), for a combined analytic sample of N = 200 (the replication paper's Table 1 prints N = 199 despite reconstructed cell counts summing to 200). Shipped erroneously recorded only the Disjunctive condition size (66), while blind listed the three condition sizes separately rather than the total test N of 200.
